SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."InternalRealEstateNumber","d"."REValuationRuleUUID","d"."REValuationProcessUUID","d"."REValuationCashFlowRecordUUID","d"."RETermNumber","d"."REValuationRule","d"."RECashFlowType","d"."CashFlowItemOrigin","d"."REStatusObject","d"."REStatusObjectAsset","d"."REConditionUUID","d"."ValidityStartDate","d"."CalculationPeriodStartDate","d"."CalculationPeriodEndDate","d"."NumberOfDays","d"."REPositionDueDate","d"."PaymentDueDate","d"."CalculationDate","d"."REConditionCurrency","d"."REInterestRate","d"."REValuationIsInitialCost","d"."REValuationIsLiabilityDiff","d"."REIsDeferralAdjustment","d"."REIsAssetRetirementObligation","d"."REValnIsCompleteRetirement","d"."REIsRetroActiveChange","d"."REValuationIsReduction","d"."REDocumentReferenceUUID","d"."REDocumentReference2UUID","d"."REDocumentReference3UUID","d"."REDocumentReference4UUID","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreationTime","d"."RESourceOfCreation","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."LastChangeTime","d"."RESourceOfChange","d"."IsReversed","d"."SplitCashFlowRecordUUID","d"."RecordIsBasisForSplit","d"."REValuationEngine","d"."RECashFlowPositionAmount","d"."RETaxType","d"."RETaxGroup","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."REIsConditionGrossAmount","d"."TaxCountry","d"."REFlowType","d"."REOriginalFlowType","d"."RERelshpOriglToFlowType","d"."CashFlowPostingStatus","d"."IsToBeArchived","d"."REOriglDueDate","d"."REConditionType","d"."PostingDate","d"."DocumentDate","d"."ExchangeRateDate","d"."REReversalForUUID","d"."REReversalByUUID","d"."REFollowUpPostingUUID","d"."REBookedFlowType","d"."RERelshpBookedToFlowType","d"."RETaxCalcDate","d"."REModifiedDueDate","d"."RECalcDueDate","d"."RECurrencyTranslationRule","d"."REIsPostInConditionCurrency","d"."REPlndTranslationDate","d"."REActlTranslationDate","d"."REOriglActlTranslationDate","d"."REIsTranslationDateFrmCashFlow","d"."TaxCalculationProcedure"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_REVALNASSETCASHFLOW_S4_CURR" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_REVALNASSETCASHFLOW'
